projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Page remapping on GH Archive batch sizes
latest.summary: On eight disjoint pairs with batch sizes and order derived from GH Archive, remapping beat every fresh-output reference. It beat the resident-buffer references in the two cases where almost all pages could be mapped. Real overlapping arrivals remain untested.
